description: The USING phrase of the ASSIGN clause (ISO §2023:12.4.5.3 GR3b / §2023:9.1.21 dynamic file assignment: the file connector is associated with the physical file named by data-name-1's content at each OPEN, SORT or MERGE), on BOTH arms of the clause - `ASSIGN TO {device-name-1 | literal-1}... USING data-name-1` and the bare `ASSIGN USING data-name-1`. A COBOL-2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): every ANSI X3.23-1985 file control entry (sequential, relative, indexed, sort-merge) prints `ASSIGN TO {implementor-name-1 | literal-1}...` only, and §1985:VII.2.3.4 GR3 reads 'The ASSIGN clause specifies the association of the file referenced by file-name-1 to a storage medium referenced by implementor-name-1 or literal-1' (§1985:VII.2.3.3 SR3: 'Literal-1 must be a nonnumeric literal and must not be a figurative constant'); §2002:12.3.4.3 GR3b adds 'When the USING phrase of the ASSIGN clause is specified, the file connector referenced by file-name-1 is associated with a physical file identified by the content of the data item referenced by data-name-1' (§2002:12.3.4.2 SR7: 'Data-name-1 shall reference an alphanumeric data item'), and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 119: 'A file may be dynamically assigned by specifying a data-name in the SELECT clause.' §2014:12.4.4.3 GR3b and §2023:12.4.5.3 GR3b carry the 2002 sentence unchanged (VCR row 7.27). GnuCOBOL 3.2 agrees (cobol85.conf `assign-using-variable: unconformable`, cobol2002.conf `ok`; kb/Work PB746), a corroboration only. Gated in ONE place, the VersionConformancePass parse arm on assignClause (the USING token appears in no other file-control rule).
display: the USING phrase of the ASSIGN clause
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWAU.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN USING WS-NAME ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(8).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME PIC X(20) VALUE "f.dat".
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN. STOP RUN.
